tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays on in all builds, with no exceptions for development builds. Alongside this, HTTPS is enforced everywhere, with no plaintext exception even for internal services.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

That goes slightly beyond verification, but it was recorded after an earlier plan to allow plain HTTP for internal hosts, so I stated it to avoid ambiguity. I didn't mention any retired alternatives.
